title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our

translated_title: 探索更多，推理更优：面向扩散语言模型的逐步风险敏感GRPO
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型通过去噪一个序列或连续的多个块来生成文本，能够并行地揭示多个 token。基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）会在这些决策中重复使用终端反馈，即使决策所依赖的上下文已经发生变化。我们提出逐步风险敏感的 GRPO（StepRS-GRPO），它在不同去噪状态之间改变群组优势变换的风险系数，同时保留底层训练器。对于二元奖励，我们证明了这种变换恰好是对中心化结果优势进行的、依赖于提示和状态的重新缩放。基于能力的校准给出了系数的合适量级，而端点与插值消融实验则指导调度方案的选择。在多个 dLLM 骨干模型和数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO 相比中心化 GRPO 提升了 pass@1 准确率和 pass@k 覆盖率，同时增加了答案多样性。
tldr: 提出StepRS-GRPO方法，通过在去噪状态间动态调整群组优势变换的风险系数，使扩散语言模型在数学推理任务上同时提升pass@1准确率、pass@k覆盖率和答案多样性。
en_tdlr: StepRS-GRPO varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation stepwise across denoising states, improving pass@1 accuracy, pass@k coverage, and answer diversity of diffusion language models on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
